description:
About our brand and products:

Realize is a modern hemp brand focused on creating products that feel great, taste amazing, and deliver an elevated experience. From fast-acting gummies and top-shelf vapes to pre-rolls and more, we build products designed for real moments, real people, and real vibes. We believe hemp should be exciting, approachable, and high quality without compromise.

What makes us different:

We’re not trying to be another generic hemp brand. Realize is built around strong branding, authentic experiences, flavor-forward products, and a community-driven culture. We focus heavily on quality, creative marketing, and building a brand people genuinely want to be part of. Our affiliates aren’t just promo pages — they’re part of the movement.

How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn commission on qualifying purchases made through their personalized affiliate links and discount codes. The more traffic and sales you generate, the more you can earn. We also regularly run promotions, launches, and giveaways to help affiliates maximize conversions and engagement.

How to promote us:

Creators promote Realize through platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, blogs, Discord communities, Snapchat, and more. Lifestyle content, reviews, comedy, gaming, storytelling, aesthetic content, and authentic product integration all perform well with our audience. We encourage creators to make content that feels natural to their brand and community.

Other information:

Approved affiliates may receive access to exclusive perks including early product launches, creator opportunities, affiliate-only promotions, and marketing assets. We’re looking for creators with strong energy, creativity, and authenticity who want to grow alongside a fast-moving brand.
